c4_disclosure.statement: Exploratory values of the primary contrast (EVO minus RS in F_test) and of other contrasts were seen before the freeze. They were computed on the exploratory test and shifted pools (spawn pool 1) with exploratory run seeds 1000 and above (D-006). No policy has been evaluated on the confirmatory test or shifted pools (spawn pool 0) and no confirmatory run seed (0 to 29) has been run. The amendments C.1 (seed count), C.2 (K = 1 overfitting measure) and C.3 (NOSEL expectation) were informed by these exploratory values; C.4 kept sigma at 0.1 despite them.
